data.title: Waiting for war: US, Israel elections feel like countdown until Iran war resumes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: First came Israel’s election. Now Americans go to the polls on Tuesday for their midterms. Once those votes are counted, Washington and Jerusalem can return to the unfinished business of Iran.
